# Contributing Guide

简体中文 | [English](.github/CONTRIBUTING.md)

---

Thank you for your interest in and contributions to releaseasy!

## Language

releaseasy is primarily maintained by a Chinese-speaking author, so some code comments, commit messages, and other project-related content may be written in Chinese.

You are welcome to contribute in **any language**. If possible, we encourage using Chinese for code comments, commit messages, and similar content to keep them consistent with the existing project. However, this is **not a requirement**.

## Before Submitting a PR

Before submitting a Pull Request, we recommend opening an Issue first to discuss your idea or proposed changes.

For larger features or architectural changes in particular, discussing them beforehand can help avoid going in the wrong direction and reduce unnecessary work.

For simple bug fixes, typo corrections, and other small changes, you can submit a PR directly without opening an Issue first.

Thank you for contributing!
